items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Washington' only in the context of Eddie Boyd's band ('When Washington dies...'). The interviewee (George Handy) does not mention any personal interaction, relationship, or direct knowledge of Washington, only narrating a fact about Boyd's band.

ctx.x: Things happened to Boyd. He didn't cause things to happen, they happened to him. He had the opportunity of rejecting them but he accepted everything that happened to him. When Washington dies, he changed his band into a jazz oriented band; he didn't stop it, he let it happen.
That was Eddie's doing, I guess. Eddie hired those people.
